com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote

Class BundleQuoteRequest

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.DefaultQuoteRequest
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.BundleQuoteRequest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    QuoteRequest, TurnAroundAware

    public class BundleQuoteRequest
extends DefaultQuoteRequest
implements QuoteRequest
    Purpose of this class is to make sure the request has a bundle on. Specifically in the case of requestion Chains, there could be huge amounts of data that can be returned. In order to save the bandwidth, eSignal provides a way to return back only the static information as a bundle. It becomes extremely important for the popular stocks/futures e.g. Crude Oil to make bundle request and then only subscribe to the selected contracts.
    Since:
    01-001-0015
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
